notes.title: Exodus Developer Plays + Q&A
notes.content:
Live play of Exodus, the game where you play as God. If you enjoy weird experimental puzzle games, this game is for you!

You embody the disembodied hand of God, experiencing a vast variety of unique and unconventional mechanics introduced throughout the game.

The game's developer will be available to answer questions about the game.
